name: Krea 2 Turbo (pose)
description: Text-to-image with Krea 2 Turbo, posed like the person in a picture. The pose is read off the picture as a skeleton and handed to the model as a reference, and a pose LoRA trained on that makes it follow the skeleton. The size follows the picture's shape at about a megapixel. Needs the Krea 2 Ostris Edit nodes.

params.label: Pose
params.description: A photo of someone in the pose you want, or — with "Detect the pose" off — a ready OpenPose skeleton. Its shape sets the size.

params.label: Detect the pose
params.description: Find the pose in the picture with SDPose and draw it as a skeleton. Turn it off when the picture already is a skeleton (coloured limbs on black).

params.label: Pose strength
params.description: The pose LoRA's strength. 0.8–1 follows the skeleton closely; lower it if the pose comes out stiff or the style drifts towards photographic.

params.label: Pose LoRA
params.description: The Krea 2 OpenPose LoRA, in `loras/`. It is what makes the model read the skeleton.

params.label: Text encoder
params.description: Must carry Qwen3-VL's vision weights, or the skeleton cannot be read.
